requirement.description: The RLP encoding implementation has several issues including incomplete fallback logic and incorrect handling of edge cases. Many tests fail due to returning '0x00' instead of proper encodings, and some tests fail due to missing dependency checks.
requirement.contract: The rlp_encode function should properly encode various data types (integers, strings, lists) according to RLP specifications. When the 'rlp' package is not available, it should gracefully fall back to manual implementation without returning placeholder values like '0x00'. Integer encoding should correctly handle all test cases including edge cases like 0, 127, 128, etc. Address encoding should properly prefix addresses with 0x94.

requirement.description: Missing dependencies for cryptographic functions. Tests requiring ecdsa and hashlib fail because these packages are not installed in the environment.
requirement.contract: The cryptographic functions (private_key_to_address, private_key_to_public_key, sign_message_hash, etc.) should properly handle missing dependencies by raising informative ImportError exceptions with installation instructions. The functions should work correctly when dependencies are present.

requirement.description: Address utility functions fail due to malformed hex strings when processing certain inputs. The function attempts to convert non-hex data to bytes using fromhex(), causing ValueErrors.
requirement.contract: The get_created_address function should properly validate and handle input data to prevent ValueError exceptions when processing addresses, salts, and init_code. It should either validate inputs or provide meaningful error messages.

requirement.description: CLI command has improper parsing logic for input data. The command doesn't properly distinguish between hex and string inputs, leading to incorrect encoding.
requirement.contract: The rlp_encode_command should correctly parse input data based on its format (hex vs string) and properly pass it to the underlying RLP encoding function. It should handle both string and hex inputs appropriately.

requirement.description: The RLP decoding function lacks proper fallback logic and doesn't correctly handle the different decoding modes ('ascii', 'raw_hex', 'prefix_hex').
requirement.contract: The rlp_decode function should properly handle different types of decoding and provide consistent behavior regardless of whether the 'rlp' package is available or not. It should correctly decode data according to the specified type.
